reviews.text: Amazing service from Kristie - she worked with us to create the most beautiful wedding displays and buttonholes. She thought so carefully about what would go well with our outfits and the venue and the result was perfect. So kind and friendly too. Thank you!! Mark and Victor
We bought some dog treats and they loved it 😍 …

I have to say their dry own brand dog food is fantastic! Grain free, 50-55% meat. My dog loves the lamb, sweet potato &  mint. I buy barking hounds wet mix, which they sell, and she scraps her plate looking for more each time. She has a sensitive tummy but this doesn’t aggravate it. If you want to support local business, this dry dogfood is excellent! Chris and all the staff are amazing! Brilliant local shop, can’t fault it!

Thank you Kristie for the fantastic flowers and excellent service provided for our Mother’s funeral service. They were all really so beautiful, Mum would have been so pleased and proud. All those who attended the service and reception echo our feelings. The stunning arrangements and the wonderful colours used were perfect and you helped make a difficult day memorable.  Yvette

Thank you so much for all your help and incredible customer service.  The time difference made for a little toing and froing - your patience was appreciated. The effort you made to deliver the plant, and the quality of the orchid plant, exceeded our expectations and we are beyond grateful.
love this shop, like a little treasure chest of plants and dog treats..
Poor driver today (4pm) in the Tottenham area. Driving wrecklessly and does not believe in signalling left or right!

I came to Kristie asking for a bridal bouquet and a buttonhole and she honestly did such a great job. I just told her the colours and some of the flowers I liked and trusted her to do the rest and honestly I’m so blown away! They were delivered to the church free of charge and the price was amazing and so reasonable. Honestly I could not be happier and I’m currently pressing my flowers to put them in a frame! Honestly such a hidden gem in Crouch end, I will be buying all flowers here!
Wellstocked, friendly staff, pillars of the community

Very friendly, accommodating and willing to help.
Wide range of pet products.
Strong local community vibe.
Highly recommended.
Great prices for outdoor plants and very friendly staff.

I’m absolutely thrilled with my purchase from this shop! I picked up this stunning fiddle leaf fig and honestly can’t believe what a bargain it was—lush, healthy, and full of life. The leaves are glossy and vibrant, and it’s already brightening up my plant corner beautifully. You can tell it’s been well cared for. The staff were friendly, knowledgeable, and made the whole experience a joy. Highly recommend to any plant lovers—you won’t be disappointed!
Friendly, knowledgeable staff. Purchased Mothers Day flowers - look great and well priced. Happy to knock up a bouquet to order
Great shop & lovely staff members super helpful.
Stunning bouquet of high quality flowers arranged by Viv looking gorgeous in our living room, very reasonably priced as well, so happy thank you!
Good range of products though shop is on the small side.
Best shop in crouchend, everyone is amazing especially Chris and mallie, quick delivery and always on point, the girls are on point and always perfect x

I’d just like to thank Kristie for making the flowers for my nieces funeral this week. When I went in to speak to her I was very emotional and she showed  me such kindness and understanding. The flowers were beautiful and we were very pleased with them. I’d definitely use her again .
